overview.metaTitle: Tavio modules: business management for Algerian SMEs
overview.metaDescription: Credit sales, CRM, invoicing, stock, accounting, point of sale, HR, projects and online shop, in one app.
overview.title: All Tavio modules
overview.body: One app to sell, invoice, manage stock and keep your team on track. Pick a module to see what it does.

detail.ctaTitle: Try Tavio with your own data
detail.ctaBody: Set up your space in a few minutes, then import your customers and products.

credit-sales.title: Credit sales
credit-sales.tagline: Instalment plans, due dates and payment reminders, without paper ledgers.
credit-sales.body: Sell on credit with confidence: every contract has its schedule, every payment is recorded and late balances are visible.
capabilities: Instalment contracts with a detailed schedule
Payments recorded against each due date

crm.title: CRM
crm.tagline: Sales pipeline, interaction history and prospect follow-up.
crm.body: Follow every prospect from the first contact to the sale, without losing track.
capabilities: Move a prospect from one stage to the next
Mark a deal won or lost, and reopen it if needed
Forms to create and edit prospects
Customer record with the history of interactions

sales-invoicing.title: Sales and invoicing
sales-invoicing.tagline: Quotes, purchase orders and invoices that follow Algerian VAT rules.
sales-invoicing.body: Create a quote, turn it into an invoice and get paid, with the mentions and VAT rates you need.
capabilities: Partial or full payments recorded on the invoice
Credit notes and refunds, fully traced

inventory-purchases.title: Stock and purchases
inventory-purchases.tagline: Warehouses, stock movements, purchase orders and supplier bills.
inventory-purchases.body: Always know what is left in stock, and restock before you run out.
capabilities: Supplier orders, goods receipt and purchase bills

accounting.title: Accounting
accounting.tagline: Journal entries, chart of accounts and control of your books.
accounting.body: Keep a clear accounting trail of your sales, purchases and payments, in dinars.
capabilities: Chart of accounts structured under the SCF
Reverse an entry in one click
Entries generated from sales, purchases and payments
Amounts in Algerian dinars, no conversion

pos.title: Point of sale
pos.tagline: Take payments at the counter, with a cash session opened and closed each day.
pos.body: A simple till for shops that stays connected to your stock and your sales.
capabilities: Sales linked to stock and invoicing

hr.title: HR
hr.body: Manage your team, leave requests and working hours without a spreadsheet.
capabilities: Check-in and check-out by the employee
Deactivate an employee without deleting them

projects-helpdesk.title: Projects and helpdesk
projects-helpdesk.tagline: Projects, tasks, time spent and customer support tickets.
projects-helpdesk.body: Organise your team's work, from site jobs to after-sales requests.
capabilities: Projects split into tasks by stage
Move tasks from one stage to the next
Ticket tracking by stage until it is closed

website-shop.title: Website and shop
website-shop.tagline: Online orders received, then turned into a sale or cancelled in one click.
website-shop.body: Receive orders from your online shop directly in your management app, with the same stock and customers.
capabilities: Convert a web order into a sale
Same stock and customers as your till

ai.title: AI assistant
ai.tagline: An assistant that answers your questions from your own data.
ai.body: Ask in French, Arabic or English, and let the assistant search and prepare reminders for you.
capabilities: Questions in French, Arabic and English about your data
Search across your customers, products and sales
Document reading (OCR) to reduce manual entry
Reminders for tasks and due dates

platform.title: Platform
platform.tagline: API, webhooks, custom fields and automations.
platform.body: Adapt Tavio to your business and connect it to the tools you already use.
capabilities: Webhooks to receive events in real time
Revoke an API key at any time
